appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
The pie chart is divided into four colored segments.
The largest segment, colored orange-red, is labeled 'Nuclear (45%)'.
The second-largest segment, colored orange, is labeled 'Renewables (10%)'.
The third-largest segment, colored yellow, is labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)'.
The fourth segment, colored red, is labeled 'Hydroelectric (30%)'.
The 'Nuclear (45%)' segment is visibly larger than the 'Hydroelectric (30%)' segment.
The 'Hydroelectric (30%)' segment is visibly larger than the 'Fossil Fuels (15%)' segment.

public_definitions: The task requires identifying the largest global energy consumption source category from the dashboard.
The dashboard is the pie chart titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
The largest category is the one with the highest percentage value shown in the chart.
The routing decision must be based on the largest category identified in the chart.
The options provided are: 'Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring', 'Escalate Hydroelectric for priority source monitoring', 'Keep Renewables on routine source monitoring'.
